template.name: sequentia/verifier-token

params.label: Reissuance token held by the covenant
params.name: TOKEN

params.label: Amount of the verifier asset a verifier covenant holds
params.name: AMOUNT

params.label: Issuer update key, which signs every spend
params.name: ISSUER_KEY

paths.effect: Reissues exactly AMOUNT of VERIFIER_ASSET on input 0, explicitly, into output 1, which pays it explicitly and with no nonce to the script whose SHA-256 is VERIFIER, and re-creates the covenant at output 0 with the token's whole amount and the same VERIFIER. The transaction has at most six outputs, each with an explicit asset, and none but output 1 carries VERIFIER_ASSET. Signed by ISSUER_KEY over the whole transaction.
paths.name: resume

paths.effect: Records the script of input 0, which must hold exactly AMOUNT of VERIFIER_ASSET explicitly, as VERIFIER: the covenant is input 1 and is re-created at output 1 with the token's whole amount, with no issuance on input 1. A halt that burns the verifier records it, so that a resume restores the policy that was halted. Signed by ISSUER_KEY over the whole transaction.
paths.name: record

slots.label: SHA-256 of the verifier covenant's scriptPubKey a resume mints into
slots.name: VERIFIER

template.summary: Holds the reissuance token of an OpenDAMP asset's verifier asset: the issuer key reissues the verifier amount only into the verifier covenant it last recorded, and records a verifier only from a coin that holds the verifier amount.

record_in_a_halt.transaction: the halt: the verifier at input 0 burned by its issuer path, the covenant at input 1 recording it, a wallet fee coin; the burn, the successor, the change and the fee

resume.transaction: the covenant as input 0 reissuing the verifier amount, a wallet fee coin; the successor, the verifier output, the change and the fee
